caption_L1: This area diagram is titled Value per head of cattle and calves in the U.S. from 2001 to 2018 (in U.S. dollars). A linear scale of range 2005 to 2015 can be seen along the x-axis, labeled Year. A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 1,500 can be seen on the y-axis, marked Value per head in U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: The value per head of cattle and calves stayed quite stable from 2000 for a few years. The value per head of cattle and calves sharply increased in 2005 to almost double the price but then fell in the next five years. After 2010 the value per head of cattle and calves once again rose sharply and for around five years, the price was almost treble what it was originally. After 2015 the value per head of cattle and calves has declined but looks to show signs of recovery and increase again.
